svg.title: Development activity
svg.desc: Authored commits per month from December 2025 to November 2026 (November partial): Dec 13, Jan 28, Feb 11, Mar 3, Apr 13, May 13, Jun 1, Jul 61, Aug 52, Sep 24, Oct 268, Nov 242. Stack over time: 2024 PHP and Laravel, 6 commits; 2025 Laravel, Filament and Livewire, 50 commits; 2026 TypeScript, NestJS, Vue, React, Laravel, Java and Spring Boot, 716 commits.
